mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dm_base.t_dm_base_module (module_code, module_name_en, module_name_chn, icon, owned_enterprise_code, module_state, over_started, remark) VALUES (#{moduleModel.moduleCode}, #{moduleModel.moduleNameEn}, #{moduleModel.moduleNameChn}, #{moduleModel.icon}, #{moduleModel.ownedEnterpriseCode}, #{moduleModel.moduleState}, #{moduleModel.overStarted}, #{moduleModel.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM dm_base.t_dm_base_module t WHERE t.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND t.delete_flag = false
SELECT count(*) FROM dm_base.t_dm_base_module t WHERE t.module_name_en = #{moduleNameEn} AND t.delete_flag = false

SELECT id, module_code, module_name_en, module_name_chn, icon, owned_enterprise_code, module_state, over_started, remark, update_time, create_time, delete_flag FROM dm_base.t_dm_base_module WHERE delete_flag = false
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_base.t_dm_base_module SET module_state = CASE WHEN module_state = true THEN false WHEN module_state = false THEN true END, over_started = true WHERE module_code = #{moduleCode} AND delete_flag = false
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_base.t_dm_base_module WHERE module_code = #{moduleCode} AND over_started = false AND delete_flag = false
